projects.intro: I am the creator and maintainer of the following open-source projects:
projects.bookcars: Car Rental Platform with Mobile App
projects.movin-in: Rental Property Management Platform with Mobile App
projects.support_1: If my projects have helped you, saved you time, run in production, support your business, or help you generate revenue, please consider giving something back. Maintaining open-source software takes significant time and effort, from development and bug fixes to security updates and releases. Your support motivates me to continue developing and maintaining these projects, keeping them active, independent, and free for everyone.
projects.support_2: You can support my work through PayPal, GitHub Sponsors, Liberapay, or Buy Me a Coffee.
projects.support_3: If you cannot contribute financially, you can still help by sharing the projects, reporting bugs, submitting pull requests, or simply saying thank you. Every bit is greatly appreciated.
books.intro: These books were previously available for purchase, but I now offer them for free so everyone can benefit from their insights.
books.light_of_truth: Light of Truth (English - PDF): This book explores different worldviews and theories about the universe and existence. Through logical reasoning, it examines creation and the purpose of life, inviting readers to reflect and seek truth with an open mind.
books.lumieres_de_verites: Lumières de vérités (Français - PDF): Ce livre explore différentes conceptions du monde et théories sur l'origine de l'univers et la nature de l'existence. Par un raisonnement logique, il invite les lecteurs à réfléchir à la création et au but de la vie, et à chercher la vérité avec un esprit ouvert.
